description: Fix O(n²) in _stage_agent_configs() called N times from _stage_agent_files() per agent, and skip pi.dev git clone backup (168MB, 21k files cache)

asi.hypothesis: agent-sync push hangs at 'Pushing local changes' due to redundant copies of pi.dev git clones
asi.root_cause_1: O(n²): _stage_agent_configs() iterates ALL agents but is called once per agent from _stage_agent_files() — the pi.dev git copy (21k files) runs 10×
asi.root_cause_2: 222MB git clone worktrees in ~/.pi/agent/git/ being copied to repo on every push (cache, not config)
asi.fix_1: Move _stage_agent_configs() call from _stage_agent_files() to _stage_all_agent_files(), called once before the agent loop
asi.fix_2: Skip git directory in pi.dev — these are cloned repos cache, not configuration. Show skip message with size.
asi.next_action_hint: Consider if other pi.dev dirs (bin, packages) should also be reviewed for backup size

description: Add 60s timeout to _run_git() subprocess calls to prevent indefinite hangs on auth/network, and add configs/pi.dev/git/ to .gitignore to prevent re-adding git clone cache

asi.hypothesis: Add safety net: git timeout prevents indefinite hangs, .gitignore prevents re-adding 21k stale git clone files
asi.metric_was_slightly_higher: expected — pushed 2 files instead of 1 (first-time .gitignore change)
asi.next_action_hint: The push is now robust. Consider checking if other pi.dev cache dirs should be reviewed.

description: Clean baseline after both fixes — push completes in 2.3s consistent

asi.note: Push is now consistently 2.2-2.6s. All three fixes working: O(n²) elimination, git clone skip, git timeout + gitignore.

description: End-to-end verification — all flags fast, push 2.2-2.9s consistent. No further optimizations needed on happy path.

asi.hypothesis: Verify all push modes are fast after three fixes
asi.conclusion: Push is fully optimized. Remaining time is network latency to GitHub (1.5s) which cannot be optimized client-side.

description: Fix pull UnicodeDecodeError crash on binary files (e.g., compiled binary in ~/.pi/agent/bin/). Replace all read_text() comparisons with _same_content() using read_bytes().

asi.hypothesis: pull crashes with UnicodeDecodeError when binary files are in pi.dev extra_paths
asi.bug: _apply_synced_configs() uses read_text() for file comparison which crashes on binary files like ~/.pi/agent/bin/fd (Mach-O executable)
asi.fix: Added SyncManager._same_content(path1, path2) static method using read_bytes() for safe binary+text comparison. Replaced all 17 read_text() comparison calls.
asi.pull_verification: pull now completes successfully (25 changes restored)
asi.scope: All _apply_synced_configs(), _apply_synced_skills(), _apply_synced_agents() — anywhere files were compared with read_text()
